libEmpty: No wallpaper found. Please set the Wallpaper Engine folders in settings.
libNoDesktop: Local scanning requires the SiYuan desktop app. In a browser, use a wallpaper URL in settings.
libSceneNote: Scene / application wallpapers cannot run in the browser; the preview image will be used as a static background.
stEnableDesc: When disabled the wallpaper is hidden and the default look is restored.
stLibraryDesc: One folder per line, e.g. the Steam workshop folder .../steamapps/workshop/content/431960 or Wallpaper Engine projects/myprojects. Leave empty to auto detect.
stLibraryPlaceholder: Empty = auto detect Steam / Wallpaper Engine folders
stLibraryActionsDesc: Detect common Steam library locations and scan wallpaper projects (project.json).
stWallpaperDesc: Supports video (mp4/webm), web (html projects) and images. Scene wallpapers fall back to their preview image.
stUrlDesc: Optional; used with priority. Any http(s) video, image or web page (the only source available in browsers).
stRotateDesc: Switch to a random wallpaper every N minutes, 0 = never.
stRandomOnStartDesc: Pick a random wallpaper on every SiYuan start.
stMaskDesc: Overlay a mask on the wallpaper to tune the brightness of the picture.
stMaskColorDesc: Black darkens the picture, white lightens it.
stMaskOpacityDesc: Higher opacity makes text easier to read.
stBlurDesc: Gaussian blur applied to the wallpaper.
stBrightnessDesc: Brightness filter of the wallpaper itself, combined with the mask.
stFitDesc: How the wallpaper fills the window. "Fit + blurred fill" shows the whole picture with a blurred copy filling the rest, so mismatched aspect ratios are never cropped (recommended).
stPositionDesc: Alignment in cover mode (X / Y percent).
stUIModeDesc: Panel backgrounds: set background color and opacity for the editor, document tree, outline, sidebar and more. Whole UI opacity: lower the opacity of the entire UI. Off: keep the UI as-is (the wallpaper stays hidden).
stUIStrengthDesc: Global multiplier of every surface opacity. Lower = more transparent = more visible wallpaper.
stMuteDesc: Video wallpapers are muted by default.
stVolumeDesc: Video wallpaper volume; above 0 unmutes automatically.
stPauseHiddenDesc: Pause the wallpaper while SiYuan is in the background.
stWebMuteDesc: Mute audio inside web wallpapers by injecting a small shim.
stQuickDesc: Left click the top bar icon for the quick panel, right click for the menu.
msgNoLibrary: The wallpaper library is empty. Please scan wallpaper folders in settings first.
sfDesc: Set background color and opacity per structure. 0% = fully transparent (wallpaper / outer background shows through), 100% = fully opaque (replaces the theme background). Theme color adapts to dark / light mode automatically; custom colors can specify a separate dark-mode color. Nested surfaces stack on top of outer ones, so set an inner one to 0% to keep it uniform.
sfPresetDesc: Apply to every surface at once; the preset currently in effect is highlighted (default: All transparent), then fine-tune each one.
stResetDesc: Restore every display option to the plugin defaults
stShortcuts: Bind hotkeys in the command palette: toggle, quick panel, library, random / previous / next, darken / lighten mask, more / less blur.
codePaletteDesc: Click a swatch to apply it; when opacity is 0% it is raised to 85% so the change is visible. Checkerboard = transparent, split tile = follow theme color. Inline code shares this background.
codeModeDesc: Theme color adapts to dark / light mode automatically; custom colors can specify a separate dark-mode color.
codeColorDesc: Left = light mode, right = dark mode. Editing either switches the source to custom.
codeOpacityDesc: 0% = fully transparent (wallpaper shows through), 100% = fully opaque. Multiplied by the overall strength in Surface backgrounds.
